name: amplio-monorepo
description: Open-code, composable semantics for wide-event telemetry

scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter @useamplio/example-basic smoke && pnpm --filter @useamplio/example-express-smoke smoke && pnpm --filter @useamplio/example-fastify-smoke smoke && pnpm --filter @useamplio/example-standalone smoke && pnpm --filter @useamplio/example-next-smoke smoke
scripts.ci: pnpm sync-registry && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm size && pnpm format:check:events && pnpm publish:smoke
scripts.registry:deploy: pnpm sync-registry && pnpm --filter @useamplio/www build && npx --yes vercel@latest deploy apps/www --prod --yes --scope aholovach
